name: Iron Roitz
source:
The protagonist of the story, commonly known as Ain.
A descendant of dark elves, he lives in seclusion within the vast forest called the "Deep Forest of Spirits". Having lost his mother to a noble's dark elf hunt during his childhood, Ain and his father retreated from human settlements to live in hiding within the Spirit Forest. However, his father succumbed to illness ten years ago.

Entrusted with the magical bow "Snyder" by his father, Ain guards it to prevent it from falling into the wrong hands while making a living as a solitary hunter.
